_notes: Shared OPR rule sanity reference. descriptions are readable reference wording; required_phrases enforce key effects even where faction phrasing differs. Source-specific exceptions require an explicit review.

Regeneration.description: Ignore a wound on a roll of 5+.

Furious.description: On a charge, unmodified melee hit rolls of 6 generate one additional hit.

Bane.description: Ignores Regeneration and makes the target re-roll unmodified Defense rolls of 6.

Caster.description: Gain X spell tokens, to a maximum of 6 held at once. Spend tokens to attempt spells; cast succeeds on 4+.
